source.title: Aramark Sports + Entertainment Kicks Off 2026 NFL Season Across Eight NFL Stadiums

notes: Official Aramark 2026 items with sections, plus official Linc local-favorites page for the 9th Street Market Pastel. South Philly Special cheesesteak skipped because Inquirer and Philly Mag disagree on 138 vs 148. Generic pretzels, calzones, and gluten-free staples not re-imported.

items.name: Broad Street Beast
items.description: Official 2026 18-inch green chalupa shell with braised wagyu beef shank, fried jalapeño poppers, tomatillo avocado salsa, Oaxaca queso, crispy shallots, and cilantro.

items.name: Tush Push Tater
items.description: Official 2026 deep-fried russet potato topped with fried chicken cutlet, pimento mac and cheese, bacon hot honey jam, 215 sauce, and scallions at East and West club markets.

items.name: Smoked BBQ Chicken Nachos
items.description: Official 2026 tortilla chips with smoked chicken in caramelized honey BBQ, roasted poblano queso, black beans, charred corn relish, mango pico, crema, and scallions.

items.name: 9th Street Market Pastel
items.description: Official this-season local item: pastel stuffed with mortadella, capicola, prosciutto cotto, and tomato relish, served with long hot aioli at section 138.

excluded.name: South Philly Special Cheesesteak
excluded.reason: Philly Mag lists 126, 129, 138; Inquirer lists 126, 129, 148. Not imported.

excluded.name: Kool-Aid Glazed Chicken Wings
excluded.reason: Philly Mag places them in FanDuel Lounge only; Aramark release did not list a section.

possibleDuplicates.evidence: Existing G'Day Gourmet pie at 111 is not the 9th Street Market Pastel. Keep both.
